title: adelia spinosa var. hirsuta
intro: Adelia spinosa var. hirsuta, commonly known as "Kakamaci" or "Cascara Sagrada" in some regions, is a plant species belonging to the Apocynaceae family. This plant has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, particularly in treating gastrointestinal issues, with its health benefits including relief from constipation, diarrhea, and other digestive problems. The therapeutic actions of Adelia spinosa var. hirsuta are attributed to its anthraquinone compounds, which have laxative and purgative effects. The bioactive constituents present in this plant include anthraquinones, such as rhein, aloe-emodin, and emodin, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
